ayahs.ar: صٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ذِي ٱلذِّكۡرِ
ayahs.en: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder
ayahs.e2: Ṣãd. By the Quran, full of reminders
ayahs.tr: Saaad; wal-Qur-aani ziz zikr

ayahs.ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي عِزَّةࣲ وَشِقَاقࣲ
ayahs.en: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension
ayahs.e2: ˹This is the truth,˺ yet the disbelievers are ˹entrenched˺ in arrogance and opposition
ayahs.tr: Balil lazeena kafaroo fee 'izzatilnw wa shiqaaq

ayahs.ar: كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنࣲ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصࣲ
ayahs.en: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape
ayahs.e2: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was too late to escape
ayahs.tr: Kam ahlaknaa min qablihim min qarnin fanaadaw wa laata heena manaas

ayahs.ar: وَعَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡۖ وَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرࣱ كَذَّابٌ
ayahs.en: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar
ayahs.e2: Now, the pagans are astonished that a warner has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, “This is a magician, a total liar
ayahs.tr: Wa 'ajibooo an jaaa'a hum munzirum minhum wa qaalal kaafiroona haazaa saahirun kazzaab

ayahs.ar: أَجَعَلَ ٱلۡأٓلِهَةَ إِلَٰهࣰا وَٰحِدًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابࣱ
ayahs.en: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing
ayahs.e2: Has he reduced ˹all˺ the gods to One God? Indeed, this is something totally astonishing.”
ayahs.tr: Aja'alal aalihata Ilaahanw Waahidan inna haazaa lashai'un 'ujaab

ayahs.ar: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱمۡشُواْ وَٱصۡبِرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمۡۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءࣱ يُرَادُ
ayahs.en: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended
ayahs.e2: The chiefs among them went forth saying, “Carry on, and stand firm in devotion to your gods. Certainly this is just a scheme ˹for power˺
ayahs.tr: Wantalaqal mala-u minhum anim shoo wasbiroo 'alaaa aalihatikum innna haazaa lashai 'uny yuraad

ayahs.ar: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَٰقٌ
ayahs.en: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication
ayahs.e2: We have never heard of this in the previous faith. This is nothing but a fabrication
ayahs.tr: Maa sami'naa bihaazaa fil millatil aakhirati in haazaaa illakh tilaaq

ayahs.ar: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكࣲّ مِّن ذِكۡرِيۚ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ
ayahs.en: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment
ayahs.e2: Has the Reminder been revealed ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us?” In fact, they are ˹only˺ in doubt of My ˹revealed˺ Reminder. In fact, ˹they do so because˺ they have not yet tasted My punishment
ayahs.tr: A-unzila 'alaihiz zikru mim baininaa; bal hum fee shakkim min Zikree bal lammaa yazooqoo 'azaab

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡوَهَّابِ
ayahs.en: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower
ayahs.e2: Or ˹is it because˺ they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord—the Almighty, the Giver ˹of all bounties˺
ayahs.tr: Am'indahum khazaaa 'inu rahmati Rabbikal 'Azeezil Wahhab

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ لَهُم مُّلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبِ
ayahs.en: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access
ayahs.e2: Or ˹is it because˺ the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between belongs to them? Let them then climb their way ˹to heaven, if their claim is true˺
ayahs.tr: Am lahum mulkus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa falyartaqoo fil asbaab

ayahs.ar: جُندࣱ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُومࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
ayahs.en: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers]
ayahs.e2: This is just another ˹enemy˺ force bound for defeat out there
ayahs.tr: Jundum maa hunaalika mahzoomum minal Ahzaab

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ وَعَادࣱ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ ذُو ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
ayahs.en: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes
ayahs.e2: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺, as did ’Âd, Pharaoh of the mighty structures
ayahs.tr: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Lootinw-wa 'Aadunw wa Fir'awnu zul awtaad

ayahs.ar: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوۡمُ لُوطࣲ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ
ayahs.en: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies
ayahs.e2: Thamûd, the people of Lot, and the residents of the Forest. These were ˹all˺ enemy forces
ayahs.tr: Wa Samoodu wa qawmu Lootinw wa Ashaabul 'Aykah; ulaaa'ikal Ahzaab

ayahs.ar: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
ayahs.en: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified
ayahs.e2: Each rejected their messenger, so My punishment was justified
ayahs.tr: In kullun illaa kazzabar Rusula fahaqqa 'iqaab

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقࣲ
ayahs.en: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay
ayahs.e2: These ˹pagans˺ are awaiting nothing but a single Blast that cannot be stopped
ayahs.tr: Wa maa yanzuru haaa ulaaa'i illaa saihatanw waahidatam maa lahaa min fawaaq

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
ayahs.en: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account
ayahs.e2: They say ˹mockingly˺, “Our Lord! Hasten for us our share ˹of the punishment˺ before the Day of Reckoning.”
ayahs.tr: Wa qaaloo Rabbanaa 'ajjil lanaa qittanaa qabla Yawmil Hisaab

ayahs.ar: ٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلۡأَيۡدِۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
ayahs.en: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah]
ayahs.e2: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And remember Our servant, David, the man of strength. Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺
ayahs.tr: Isbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wazkur 'abdanaa Daawooda zal aidi aidi innahooo awwaab

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا ٱلۡجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِشۡرَاقِ
ayahs.en: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise
ayahs.e2: We truly subjected the mountains to hymn ˹Our praises˺ along with him in the evening and after sunrise
ayahs.tr: Innaa sakhkharnal jibaala ma'ahoo yusabbihna bil'ashaiyi wal ishraaq

ayahs.ar: وَٱلطَّيۡرَ مَحۡشُورَةࣰۖ كُلࣱّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابࣱ
ayahs.en: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises]
ayahs.e2: And ˹We subjected˺ the birds, flocking together. All turned to him ˹echoing his hymns˺
ayahs.tr: Wattayra mahshoorah; kullul lahooo awwaab

ayahs.ar: وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ ٱلۡخِطَابِ
ayahs.en: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech
ayahs.e2: We strengthened his kingship, and gave him wisdom and sound judgment
ayahs.tr: Wa shadadnaa mulkahoo wa aatainaahul Hikmata wa faslal khitaab

ayahs.ar: ۞وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَصۡمِ إِذۡ تَسَوَّرُواْ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابَ
ayahs.en: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber
ayahs.e2: Has the story of the two plaintiffs, who scaled the ˹wall of David’s˺ sanctuary, reached you ˹O Prophet˺
ayahs.tr: Wa hal ataaka naba'ul khasm; iz tasawwarul mihraab

ayahs.ar: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنۡهُمۡۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ خَصۡمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعۡضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تُشۡطِطۡ وَٱهۡدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
ayahs.en: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path
ayahs.e2: When they came into David’s presence, he was startled by them. They said, “Have no fear. ˹We are merely˺ two in a dispute: one of us has wronged the other. So judge between us with truth—do not go beyond ˹it˺—and guide us to the right way
ayahs.tr: Iz dakhaloo 'alaa Daawooda fafazi'a minhum qaaloo la takhaf khasmaani baghaa ba'dunaa 'alaa ba'din fahkum bainanaaa bilhaqqi wa laa tushtit wahdinaaa ilaa Sawaaa'is Siraat

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِي لَهُۥ تِسۡعࣱ وَتِسۡعُونَ نَعۡجَةࣰ وَلِيَ نَعۡجَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ فَقَالَ أَكۡفِلۡنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي ٱلۡخِطَابِ
ayahs.en: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech
ayahs.e2: This is my brother. He has ninety-nine sheep while I have ˹only˺ one. ˹Still˺ he asked me to give it up to him, overwhelming me with ˹his˺ argument.”
ayahs.tr: Inna haazaaa akhee lahoo tis'unw wa tis'oona na'jatanw wa liya na'jatunw waahidah; faqaala akfilneeha wa 'azzanee filkhitaab

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَقَدۡ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعۡجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرࣰا مِّنَ ٱلۡخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبۡغِي بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلࣱ مَّا هُمۡۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسۡتَغۡفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّۤ رَاكِعࣰ اۤ وَأَنَابَ۩
ayahs.en: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah]
ayahs.e2: David ˹eventually˺ ruled, “He has definitely wronged you in demanding ˹to add˺ your sheep to his. And certainly many partners wrong each other, except those who believe and do good—but how few are they!” Then David realized that We had tested him so he asked for his Lord’s forgiveness, fell down in prostration, and turned ˹to Him in repentance˺
ayahs.tr: Qaala laqad zalamaka bisu 'aali na'jatika ilaa ni'aajihee wa inna kaseeram minal khulataaa'i la-yabghee ba'duhum 'alaa ba'din illal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati wa qaleehum maa hum; wa zanna Daawoodu annamaa fatannaahu fastaghrara Rabbahoo wa kharra raaki'anw wa anaab

ayahs.ar: فَغَفَرۡنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابࣲ
ayahs.en: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return
ayahs.e2: So We forgave that for him. And he will indeed have ˹a status of˺ closeness to Us and an honourable destination
ayahs.tr: Faghafarnaa lahoo zaalik; wa inna lahoo 'indanaa lazulfaa wa husna ma aab

ayahs.ar: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةࣰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابࣱ شَدِيدُۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
ayahs.en: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account
ayahs.e2: ˹We instructed him:˺ “O David! We have surely made you an authority in the land, so judge between people with truth. And do not follow ˹your˺ desires or they will lead you astray from Allah’s Way. Surely those who go astray from Allah’s Way will suffer a severe punishment for neglecting the Day of Reckoning.”
ayahs.tr: Yaa Daawoodu innaa ja'alnaaka khaleefatan fil ardi fahkum bainan naasi bilhaqqi wa laa tattabi'il hawaa fayudillaka 'an sabeelil laah; innal lazeena yadilloona 'an sabeelil laah; lahum 'azaabun shadeedum bimaa nasoo Yawmal Hisaab

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا بَٰطِلࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.en: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire
ayahs.e2: We have not created the heavens and earth and everything in between without purpose—as the disbelievers think. So woe to the disbelievers because of the Fire
ayahs.tr: Wa ma khalaqnas samaaa'a wal arda wa maa bainahumaa baatilaa; zaalika zannul lazeena kafaroo; fawi lul lillazeena kafaroo minan Naar

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلۡفُجَّارِ
ayahs.en: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked
ayahs.e2: Or should We treat those who believe and do good like those who make mischief throughout the land? Or should We treat the righteous like the wicked
ayahs.tr: Am naj'alul lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati kalmufisdeena fil ardi am naj'alul muttaqeena kalfujjaar

ayahs.ar: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡكَ مُبَٰرَكࣱ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
ayahs.en: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded
ayahs.e2: ˹This is˺ a blessed Book which We have revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺ so that they may contemplate its verses, and people of reason may be mindful
ayahs.tr: Kitaabun anzalnaahu ilaika mubaarakul liyaddabbarooo Aayaatihee wa liyatazakkara ulul albaab

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
ayahs.en: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah]
ayahs.e2: And We blessed David with Solomon—what an excellent servant ˹he was˺! Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺
ayahs.tr: Wa wahabnaa li Daawooda Sulaimaan; ni'mal 'abd; innahoo awwaab

ayahs.ar: إِذۡ عُرِضَ عَلَيۡهِ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلۡجِيَادُ
ayahs.en: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses
ayahs.e2: ˹Remember˺ when the well-trained, swift horses were paraded before him in the evening
ayahs.tr: Iz 'urida 'alaihi bil'ashiy yis saafinaatul jiyaad

ayahs.ar: فَقَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَحۡبَبۡتُ حُبَّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتۡ بِٱلۡحِجَابِ
ayahs.en: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]
ayahs.e2: He then proclaimed, “I am truly in love with ˹these˺ fine things out of remembrance for Allah,” until they went out of sight
ayahs.tr: Faqaala inneee ahbabtu hubbal khairi 'an zikri Rabbee hattaa tawaarat bilhijaab

ayahs.ar: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسۡحَۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَاقِ
ayahs.en: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks
ayahs.e2: ˹He ordered,˺ “Bring them back to me!” Then he began to rub down their legs and necks
ayahs.tr: Ruddoohaa 'alaiya fatafiqa masham bissooqi wal a'naaq

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا عَلَىٰ كُرۡسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدࣰا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
ayahs.en: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned
ayahs.e2: And indeed, We tested Solomon, placing a ˹deformed˺ body on his throne, then he turned ˹to Allah in repentance˺
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad fatannaa Sulaimaana wa alqainaa 'alaa kursiyyihee jasadan summa anaab

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَهَبۡ لِي مُلۡكࣰا لَّا يَنۢبَغِي لِأَحَدࣲ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower
ayahs.e2: He prayed, “My Lord! Forgive me, and grant me an authority that will never be matched by anyone after me. You are indeed the Giver ˹of all bounties˺.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala Rabbigh fir lee wa hab lee mulkal laa yambaghee li ahadim mim ba'de inaka Antal Wahhab

ayahs.ar: فَسَخَّرۡنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجۡرِي بِأَمۡرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيۡثُ أَصَابَ
ayahs.en: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed
ayahs.e2: So We subjected to him the wind, blowing gently at his command to wherever he pleased
ayahs.tr: Fasakhkharnaa lahur reeha tajree bi amrihee rukhaaa'an haisu asaab

ayahs.ar: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءࣲ وَغَوَّاصࣲ
ayahs.en: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver
ayahs.e2: And ˹We subjected to him˺ every builder and diver of the jinn
ayahs.tr: Wash Shayaateena kulla bannaaa'inw wa ghawwaas

ayahs.ar: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَصۡفَادِ
ayahs.en: And others bound together in shackles
ayahs.e2: and others bound together in chains
ayahs.tr: Wa aakhareena muqarraneena fil asfaad

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمۡنُنۡ أَوۡ أَمۡسِكۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابࣲ
ayahs.en: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account
ayahs.e2: ˹Allah said,˺ “This is Our gift, so give or withhold ˹as you wish˺, never to be called to account.”
ayahs.tr: Haazaa 'ataaa'unaa famnun aw amsik bighairi hisaab

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابࣲ
ayahs.en: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return
ayahs.e2: And he will indeed have ˹a status of˺ closeness to Us and an honourable destination
ayahs.tr: Wa inna lahoo 'indanaa lazulfaa wa husna ma-aab

ayahs.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ بِنُصۡبࣲ وَعَذَابٍ
ayahs.en: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment
ayahs.e2: And remember Our servant Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “Satan has afflicted me with distress and suffering.”
ayahs.tr: Wazkur 'abdanaaa Ayyoob; iz naada Rabbahooo annee massaniyash Shaitaanu binus binw wa 'azaab

ayahs.ar: ٱرۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَۖ هَٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلُۢ بَارِدࣱ وَشَرَابࣱ
ayahs.en: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink
ayahs.e2: ˹We responded,˺ “Stomp your foot: ˹now˺ here is a cool ˹and refreshing˺ spring for washing and drinking.”
ayahs.tr: Urkud birijlika haaza mughtasalum baaridunw wa sharaab

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهۡلَهُۥ وَمِثۡلَهُم مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّا وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
ayahs.en: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding
ayahs.e2: And We gave him back his family, twice as many, as a mercy from Us and a lesson for people of reason
ayahs.tr: Wa wahabnaa lahoo ahlahoo wa mislahum ma'ahum rahmatam minna wa zikraa li ulil albaab

ayahs.ar: وَخُذۡ بِيَدِكَ ضِغۡثࣰا فَٱضۡرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحۡنَثۡۗ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَٰهُ صَابِرࣰ اۚ نِّعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابࣱ
ayahs.en: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah]
ayahs.e2: ˹And We said to him,˺ “Take in your hand a bundle of grass, and strike ˹your wife˺ with it, and do not break your oath.” We truly found him patient. What an excellent servant ˹he was˺! Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺
ayahs.tr: Wa khuz biyadika dighsan fadrib bihee wa laa tahnas, innaa wajadnaahu saabiraa; ni'mal 'abd; innahooo awwaab

ayahs.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ أُوْلِي ٱلۡأَيۡدِي وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
ayahs.en: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision
ayahs.e2: And remember Our servants: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—the men of strength and insight
ayahs.tr: Wazkur 'ibaadanaaa Ibraaheema wa Is-haaqa wa Ya'qooba ulil-aydee walabsaar

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَخۡلَصۡنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةࣲ ذِكۡرَى ٱلدَّارِ
ayahs.en: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter]
ayahs.e2: We truly chose them for the honour of proclaiming the Hereafter
ayahs.tr: Innaaa akhlasnaahum bi khaalisatin zikrad daar

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّهُمۡ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصۡطَفَيۡنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
ayahs.en: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding
ayahs.e2: And in Our sight they are truly among the chosen and the finest
ayahs.tr: Wa innahum 'indanaa laminal mustafainal akhyaar

ayahs.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ وَكُلࣱّ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
ayahs.en: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding
ayahs.e2: Also remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Ⱬul-Kifl. All are among the best
ayahs.tr: Wazkur Ismaa'eela wal Yasa'a wa Zal-Kifli wa kullum minal akhyaar

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا ذِكۡرࣱۚ وَإِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابࣲ
ayahs.en: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return
ayahs.e2: This is ˹all˺ a reminder. And the righteous will certainly have an honourable destination
ayahs.tr: Haazaa zikr; wa inna lilmuttaqeena lahusna ma aab

ayahs.ar: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنࣲ مُّفَتَّحَةࣰ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡوَٰبُ
ayahs.en: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them
ayahs.e2: the Gardens of Eternity, whose gates will be open for them
ayahs.tr: Jannaati 'adnim mufat tahatal lahumul abwaab

ayahs.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةࣲ كَثِيرَةࣲ وَشَرَابࣲ
ayahs.en: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink
ayahs.e2: There they will recline, calling for abundant fruit and drink
ayahs.tr: Muttaki'eena feehaa yad'oona feehaa bifaakihatin kaseeratinw wa sharaab

ayahs.ar: ۞وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ أَتۡرَابٌ
ayahs.en: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age
ayahs.e2: And with them will be maidens of modest gaze and equal age
ayahs.tr: Wa 'indahum qaasiraatut tarfi atraab

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
ayahs.en: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account
ayahs.e2: This is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning
ayahs.tr: Haaza maa too'odoona li Yawmil Hisaab

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزۡقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
ayahs.en: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion
ayahs.e2: This is indeed Our provision that will never end
ayahs.tr: Inna haazaa larizqunaa maa lahoo min nafaad

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَاۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابࣲ
ayahs.en: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return
ayahs.e2: That is that. And the transgressors will certainly have the worst destination
ayahs.tr: Haazaa; wa inna littaagheena lasharra ma-aab

ayahs.ar: جَهَنَّمَ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمِهَادُ
ayahs.en: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place
ayahs.e2: Hell, where they will burn. What an evil place to rest
ayahs.tr: Jahannama yaslawnahaa fai'sal mihaad

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا فَلۡيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمࣱ وَغَسَّاقࣱ
ayahs.en: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence
ayahs.e2: Let them then taste this: boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus
ayahs.tr: Haazaa falyazooqoohu hameemunw wa ghassaaq

ayahs.ar: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكۡلِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٌ
ayahs.en: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds
ayahs.e2: and other torments of the same sort
ayahs.tr: Wa aakharu min shak liheee azwaaj

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا فَوۡجࣱ مُّقۡتَحِمࣱ مَّعَكُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِهِمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ صَالُواْ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.en: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire
ayahs.e2: ˹The misleaders will say to one another,˺ “Here is a crowd ˹of followers˺ being thrown in with us. They are not welcome, ˹for˺ they ˹too˺ will burn in the Fire.”
ayahs.tr: Haazaa fawjum muqtahimum ma'akum laa marhabam bihim; innahum saalun Naar

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِكُمۡۖ أَنتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوهُ لَنَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ
ayahs.en: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement
ayahs.e2: The followers will respond, “No! You are not welcome! You brought this upon us. What an evil place for settlement!”
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo bal antum laa marhabam bikum; antum qaddamtumoohu lanaa fabi'sal qaraar

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدۡهُ عَذَابࣰا ضِعۡفࣰا فِي ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.en: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire
ayahs.e2: Adding, “Our Lord! Whoever brought this upon us, double their punishment in the Fire.”
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo Rabbanaa man qaddama lanaa haaza fazidhu 'azaaban di'fan fin Naar

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُواْ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالࣰا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَشۡرَارِ
ayahs.en: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst
ayahs.e2: The tyrants will ask ˹one another˺, “But why do we not see those we considered to be lowly
ayahs.tr: Wa qaaloo ma lanaa laa naraa rijaalan kunnaa na'udduhum minal ashraar

ayahs.ar: أَتَّخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا أَمۡ زَاغَتۡ عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ
ayahs.en: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them
ayahs.e2: Were we wrong in mocking them ˹in the world˺? Or do our eyes ˹just˺ fail to see them ˹in the Fire˺?”
ayahs.tr: Attakhaznaahum sikh riyyan am zaaghat 'anhumul absaar

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقࣱّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهۡلِ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.en: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire
ayahs.e2: This dispute between the residents of the Fire will certainly come to pass
ayahs.tr: Inna zaalika lahaqqun takhaasumu Ahlin Naar

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرࣱۖ وَمَا مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing
ayahs.e2: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I am only a warner. And there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah—the One, the Supreme
ayahs.tr: Qul innamaaa ana munzirunw wa maa min ilaahim illal laahul Waahidul Qahhaar

ayahs.ar: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرُ
ayahs.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver
ayahs.e2: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between—the Almighty, Most Forgiving.”
ayahs.tr: Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumal 'Azeezul Ghaffaar

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ هُوَ نَبَؤٌاْ عَظِيمٌ
ayahs.en: Say, "It is great news
ayahs.e2: Say, “This ˹Quran˺ is momentous news
ayahs.tr: Qul huwa naba'un 'azeem

ayahs.ar: أَنتُمۡ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضُونَ
ayahs.en: From which you turn away
ayahs.e2: from which you ˹pagans˺ are turning away.”
ayahs.tr: Antum 'anhu mu'ridoon

ayahs.ar: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنۡ عِلۡمِۭ بِٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰٓ إِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُونَ
ayahs.en: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam]
ayahs.e2: ˹And say,˺ “I had no knowledge of the highest assembly ˹in heaven˺ when they differed ˹concerning Adam˺
ayahs.tr: Maa kaana liya min 'ilmim bilmala il a'laaa iz yakhtasimoon

ayahs.ar: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.en: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner
ayahs.e2: What is revealed to me is that I am only sent with a clear warning.”
ayahs.tr: Iny-yoohaaa ilaiya illaaa annnamaaa ana nazeerum mubeen

ayahs.ar: إِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرࣰا مِّن طِينࣲ
ayahs.en: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay
ayahs.e2: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from clay
ayahs.tr: Iz qaala Rabbuka lilmalaaa'ikati innee khaaliqum basharam min teen

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.en: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration
ayahs.e2: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”
ayahs.tr: Fa-iza sawwaituhoo wa nafakhtu feehi mir roohee faqa'oo lahoo saajideen

ayahs.ar: فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ
ayahs.en: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely
ayahs.e2: So the angels prostrated all together—
ayahs.tr: Fasajadal malaaa'ikatu kulluhum ajma'oon

ayahs.ar: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.en: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers
ayahs.e2: but not Iblîs, who acted arrogantly, becoming unfaithful
ayahs.tr: Illaaa Iblees; istakbara wa kaana minal kaafireen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسۡجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقۡتُ بِيَدَيَّۖ أَسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَالِينَ
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty
ayahs.e2: Allah asked, “O Iblîs! What prevented you from prostrating to what I created with My Own Hands? Did you ˹just˺ become proud? Or have you always been arrogant?”
ayahs.tr: Qaala yaaa Ibleesu maa man'aka an tasjuda limaa khalaqtu biyadai; astakbarta am kunta min 'aaleen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡهُ خَلَقۡتَنِي مِن نَّارࣲ وَخَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن طِينࣲ
ayahs.en: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay
ayahs.e2: He replied, “I am better than he is: You created me from fire and him from clay.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala ana khairum minah; khalaqtanee min naarinw wa khalaqtahoo min teen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمࣱ
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled
ayahs.e2: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed
ayahs.tr: Qaala fakhruj minhaa fainnaka rajeem

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ لَعۡنَتِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.en: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense
ayahs.e2: And surely upon you is My condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”
ayahs.tr: Wa inna 'alaika la'nateee ilaa Yawmid Deen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected
ayahs.e2: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala Rabbi fa anzirneee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
ayahs.e2: Allah said, “You will be delayed
ayahs.tr: Qaala fa innaka minal munzareen

ayahs.ar: إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡوَقۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡلُومِ
ayahs.en: Until the Day of the time well-known
ayahs.e2: until the appointed Day.”
ayahs.tr: Ilaa Yawmil waqtil ma'loom

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.en: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all
ayahs.e2: Satan said, “By Your Glory! I will certainly mislead them all
ayahs.tr: Qaala fabi'izzatika la ughwiyannahum ajma'een

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
ayahs.en: Except, among them, Your chosen servants
ayahs.e2: except Your chosen servants among them.”
ayahs.tr: Illaa 'ibaadaka minhumul mukhlaseen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَٱلۡحَقُّ وَٱلۡحَقَّ أَقُولُ
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say
ayahs.e2: Allah concluded, “The truth is—and I ˹only˺ say the truth—
ayahs.tr: Qaala falhaqq, walhaqqa aqool

ayahs.ar: لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.en: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together
ayahs.e2: I will surely fill up Hell with you and whoever follows you from among them, all together.”
ayahs.tr: La amla'annna Jahannama minka wa mimman tabi'aka minhum ajma'een

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرࣲ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious
ayahs.e2: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹Quran˺, nor do I pretend to be someone I am not
ayahs.tr: Qul maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrinw wa maaa ana minal mutakallifeen

ayahs.ar: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرࣱ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.en: It is but a reminder to the worlds
ayahs.e2: It is only a reminder to the whole world
ayahs.tr: In huwa illaa zikrul lil'aalameen

ayahs.ar: وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعۡدَ حِينِۭ
ayahs.en: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time
ayahs.e2: And you will certainly know its truth before long.”
ayahs.tr: Wa lata'lamunna naba ahoo ba'da heen
